messages:
Maria H: Nightly eval dropped badly on long_context_promptset_v2 for redwood-open-7b-q8_0 — 23% lower pass rate vs baseline. Many examples get truncated partway through the instruction or lose the last sentence. eval-bot reported 'generation_ended_early' for 48 examples.
Jae K: :eyes: link to the failing batch? can you paste a few raw generations and the prompt?
Maria H: Pasting a repro and two examples. Repro command we used from harness:
```
python3 eval/run_eval.py --model redwood-open-7b-q8_0 --promptset long_context_promptset_v2 --max_tokens 1024 --stream False --seed 42
```
Failing example 1 prompt (truncated for thread): "You are an assistant reading a long contract... summarize obligations after section 18..."
Baseline (redwood-open-7b): "...the obligations are A, B, C. Additionally, the party must..."
Quantized (q8_0) generation: "...the obligations are A, B," <stops>
Failing example 2: instruction gets repeated then stops mid-sentence.
Maria H: Also saw log lines from runtime: `WARN kv_cache: write_index 4096 > cache_capacity 4096 -> resizing` and a handful of `KV cache miss at step=512` entries.
Alex P: Hmm KV cache hitting capacity is suspicious. Was this model served with the new rolling-kv patch? I thought that change was only on dedicated pools but maybe it shipped to staging.
Sophie Q: QA saw similar truncation on quantized 7b variants a few nights ago but we chalked it up to eval harness timeout. These look different — partial sentence stop not a timeout token.
Jae K: Can we repro locally with the same runtime version? Maria, which runtime build digest did the nightly use?
Maria H: Nightly used runtime v2.14.1 (sha: a1b2c3d). I just repro'd locally with the same docker image and see the truncation.
Jae K: Repro steps I'll try: 1) run with `--disable_kv_cache` flag, 2) run with `--max_length` reduced to 512, 3) run unquantized model for comparison. Can you paste exact JSON payload you sent to the serving endpoint?
Maria H: Payload snippet:
```
{"prompt": "<long prompt>...","max_new_tokens": 1024, "temperature": 0.0, "return_full_text": false}
```
Jae K: Thanks. Quick test results: disabling kv cache locally removes truncation (outputs complete). With kv cache enabled we hit the write_index warning and the generation cuts. So it's KV-centric.
Alex P: That suggests a bug in the KV rollover logic where write_index == capacity triggers a fence that causes the token loop to see end-of-stream. Maybe an off-by-one when computing available slots after quantization blocks.
Sophie Q: We should also check whether quantized kernels change the tokenization/chunking so the cache length estimate is off. Could be we undercount tokens per step.
Maria H: Agreed. Observed that the quantified model emits slightly different token counts for the same prompt compared to baseline (off by 1-2 tokens on long tails).
Jae K: Action plan: (1) Alex to grep commit range for rolling-kv and quantization interactions, (2) I will run microbench reproducer that logs kv write_index, capacity, and step for every token, (3) Maria/Sophie to assemble failing prompt set + golden outputs and pin as test. I'll open a ticket.
Alex P: I found a candidate commit: `runtime: enforce_kv_capacity_at_step` merged in v2.14.0 — it clamps write_index using floor(div(token_bytes, chunk_size)) which may behave differently under quantized kernel padding.
Jae K: If that's it, quick patch is to change clamp to allow equality (<=) instead of (<) and add safety to not emit early-end. I'll prototype.
Maria H: Created ticket INF-1198 with failing examples, logs, and reproducer. Tagging the ticket to `eng-runtime` and `eng-ml`. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-1198
infra-bot: nightly-eval-alert: long_context_promptset_v2 failed on model redwood-open-7b-q8_0 (23% delta). Details posted to ticket INF-1198.
Jae K: Prototype patch pushed to PR #4826 with a unit test that simulates the quantized token padding. Can folks review today? It's a small change in kv_store.cpp.
Alex P: Reviewed and left one comment about edge-case when capacity == 0 (no kv). LGTM otherwise.
Sophie Q: QA will run the nightly harness against the PR build on dedicated staging and rerun the long_context set. If green we'll backport to v2.14.x.
Maria H: Thanks all. For tracking: if QA passes we plan a hotfix to the dedicated pool overnight. Please add any additional logs to INF-1198. :thumbsup:
